messages:
maria: heads-up — legal asked if our audit UI can surface "who" + "why" for routing policy changes in a single view. they want to download slices for compliance reviews.
aj: quick q: do they need full payload diffs or just before/after summary?
maria: summary is fine for first pass, but must be able to expand to full diff on demand. also they asked to link to rollout ids so reviewers can see canary vs full. :eyes:
samir: we currently store change events with fields: actor_email, action, timestamp, resource, change_blob (json), rollout_id, request_id. export endpoint is /api/v1/audit/exports — supports ndjson and csv now.

olivia: CSV loses context for nested fields. ndjson is better but we should add a compact "summary" field to make the UI/table friendly. e.g. summary = "updated routing.policy weight: 0.2 -> 0.5"
maria: agree. compliance also asked for ability to filter by rollout_id, actor, time-range, and export only events that affected a given model or route. can this be server-side predicate pushdown?
aj: yes — backend can accept predicates. proposal: add query params like ?actor=...&resource=routes/route-123&rollout_id=rl_456&format=ndjson&summary=true&mask_pii=true

samir: implementation notes: we should avoid duplicating blobs in export. we can stream ndjson lines like:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-10T14:12:23Z","actor_email":"alice@example.com","action":"update","resource":"routes/route-123","rollout_id":"rl_456","summary":"weight 0.2 -> 0.5","change_path":"routing.policy.weights[1]","request_id":"req_9ab"}
{"timestamp":"2026-03-10T14:12:23Z","actor_email":"alice@example.com","action":"update","resource":"routes/route-123","rollout_id":"rl_456","change_blob":"{\"routing\":{\"policy\":{\"weights\":[0.2,0.5]}}}","request_id":"req_9ab","detail_type":"full_blob"}
```

olivia: nice. for UI table we show only the first line (summary). clicking expands to show the full_blob line linked by request_id.
maria: legal also wants retention metadata in the export header (exported_by, export_time, retention_cutoff). include that as the first NDJSON line with type:meta?
aj: yep we can prepend a meta line: {"type":"export_meta","exported_by":"maria","export_time":"...","retention_cutoff":"2025-12-01"}

samir: security note: default mask_pii=true for exports unless requester has compliance:read scope. mask emails -> actor_id. and redact tokens/keys from change_blob.

maria: action items: 1) samir, add summary+rollout_id fields to audit producer and ndjson stream. 2) aj, extend export API params and include meta header. 3) olivia, mockup UI expand behavior and the download UX. i'll sync with legal after prototypes.
audit-bot: export_job queued by maria (job_id: ex_20260310_77).

olivia: will sketch by EOD, keeping rows compact. showing actor (masked), action, resource, summary, rollout badge. expand inline for diffs.
aj: i'll add query param docs to the openapi draft and push a small PR.
maria: perfect — thanks team. if anyone wants to join the sync with legal tomorrow at 10am, ping me. :thumbsup:
